title: Special Topics in Persian Studies; Modular Studies of Persian Arts
description:
Restricted to students in the Persian MPS program.

This sheltered, content-based course focuses on the development of superior proficiency in Persian language and culture through the lens ofthe Persian arts. Invited experts from domains such as architecture, performing arts, calligraphy, and painting will lead modules while students engage in scaffolded language activities across all skills related to these fields.
